content.title: About
content.content: Monster is a popular energy drink containing caffeine, taurine, B‑vitamins and sugar (or sugar substitutes). It is sold in various flavors and sizes, including a 550 ml can. The drink is intended to boost alertness and concentration.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first Monster drink was launched in 2002 by Monster Beverage Corporation.
The brand is known for its bold can design with the iconic “M” logo and aggressive marketing in extreme sports.
A typical 500 ml can contains about 160 mg of caffeine, roughly equivalent to two cups of coffee.
There are more than 30 flavors, including the original “Original”, sugar‑free “Zero Ultra”, and tropical “Pipeline Punch”.
Monster sponsors numerous music festivals, esports teams and athletes.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, temporarily increasing alertness and reducing perceived fatigue.

items.title: Improved focus
items.content: B‑vitamins (B2, B3, B6, B12) support energy metabolism and may help maintain cognitive performance.

items.title: Recovery aid
items.content: Taurine and electrolytes (sodium, potassium) help maintain fluid balance during intense physical activity.

items.title: Excessive caffeine intake
items.content: High caffeine doses can cause anxiety, insomnia, rapid heartbeat and increased blood pressure.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Regular versions contain up to 55 g of sugar per 500 ml, which may contribute to weight gain and dental caries.

items.title: Interaction with alcohol
items.content: Mixing energy drinks with alcohol can mask intoxication, raising the risk of overexertion.

items.title: Not recommended for children and pregnant women
items.content: Due to high caffeine and stimulant levels, the product is not advised for people under 18, pregnant or nursing women.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Drink Monster chilled, straight from the can. A typical serving is 250–500 ml over 2–3 hours. Do not exceed 2–3 cans per day, especially if you are caffeine‑sensitive.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, consume within 24 hours for best taste.
